== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|King [[Dakata]], also known as King Seishen [[Dakata]], is the ruler of the [[Seishen Kingdom]]. A powerful warrior who united his realm through personal combat, he possesses a physical build reminiscent of an aging bear and is often seen wearing gray [[Forged]] armor. He wields a massive sword and a heavy metal shield decorated with a lion's face, and he is capable of utilizing a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] for travel. [[Dakata]] constructed a stone castle in the [[Night Wheel Valley]] to serve as a symbol of his kingdom's majesty, though it is dwarfed by the fortifications of the [[Akura clan]]. [[Dakata]]'s leadership is characterized by a complex relationship with the [[Akura clan]]. While he has expressed deep respect and even submissive loyalty toward the [[Sages]], his kingdom has faced accusations of conspiracy regarding an assassination attempt against [[Akura clan|Akura family]] members. This led to a period of imprisonment and interrogation for both the King and his remaining heir, [[Seishen Daji|Prince Daji]]. Despite these tensions, [[Dakata]] has demonstrated a desire to prove the [[Seishen Kingdom]]'s worth through service and contribution. He is a father deeply concerned with his sons, [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]] and [[Seishen Daji|Daji]], and has shown both immense pride in their roles and profound distress regarding their fates.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|King [[Dakata]] is an older man. He possesses a physical build comparable to a noble bear.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As an Overlord, he has the power to cycle strength into his spirit from the [[vital aura]].}}
